svg.title: How IBM Envizi turns ESG data into a report
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Capture: pull structured and unstructured data from ERP systems, IoT and metering platforms, utility providers, spreadsheets and supplier portals. Calculate: an emissions calculation engine built on the GHG Protocol, for Scope 1, 2 and 3. Report: ESG reporting frameworks, building ratings and benchmarks, and target setting and tracking, with every change logged.
